policy: Rotation policy for the runtime secret inventory, projected from docs/runbook/infisical-secrets.md section 2.1 (the Cadence column) so a deadline is a computable fact instead of prose. Status-only by contract: a row holds a NAME, a cadence and a date. A secret value is never a legal field here, and scripts/_secret-rotation-status.mjs rejects an unknown key rather than storing it. `last_rotated_at` is null for every row because this repository cannot know when an operator rotated a production secret; the owner records the date in the same PR as the rotation. Until then the gate reports UNRECORDED as an advisory, never as a match.

cadence.label: only as part of the BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS envelope rotation
on suspected compromise or as needed (pair rotation: Infisical prod + Worker binding + D1 apikey row)

secrets.name: GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_MEASUREMENT_ID
secrets.driver: operator edit in the Infisical dashboard (docs/runbook/analytics.md); there is no rotation script for a public measurement ID
